domain_velocity.description: How many legitimate users the domain has: high, medium, low or none. Upgraded plans only.

email.description: The email address that was checked.

first_name.description: The first name the address suggests. CORPORATE for a company address, UNKNOWN when there is none.

first_seen.description: When IPQS first saw the address, an estimate of how old it is. Its fields are null when unknown.

human.description: How long ago, in words, e.g. 3 months ago. Null when unknown.

iso.description: The moment in ISO 8601, e.g. 2019-09-09T16:40:34-04:00. Null when unknown.

timestamp.description: The moment as Unix time (seconds since 1970), e.g. 1568061634. Null when unknown.

fraud_score.description: IPQS's fraud score for the address, 0 to 100, from its reputation and recent behavior. 75 and above is suspicious, 80 and above is suspicious for user scoring, and 90 and above is risky.

frequent_complainer.description: Whether the address often unsubscribes or reports mail as spam.

generic.description: Whether the address is a shared one for a domain, such as admin@, sales@ or contact@.

honeypot.description: Whether the address is believed to be a honeypot or spam trap. Bulk mail sent to one risks getting a sender blocked.

identity_data.description: An Enterprise add-on: identity details from authoritative sources such as credit bureaus and telecoms, one entry per person, with names, addresses, email addresses, phone numbers and age, exactly as IPQS sends them. Null when the account does not have the add-on.

leaked.description: Whether the address was in a recent data breach, which puts its accounts at risk of takeover.

overall_score.description: Overall validity, 0 to 4: 0 invalid, 1 the mail server cannot be reached, 2 a temporary rejection, 3 the server accepts all mail, 4 the address is verified. Above 1 can be a valid address.

recent_abuse.description: Whether IPQS has verified abuse from the address in the past few days: a chargeback, fake sign up, compromised device and the like.

recent_data_matches.description: How often IPQS has seen the values sent in this lookup over the last 7 days, one entry per value. Empty when it has none to report.

recent_occurrences.description: How many times IPQS has seen it in the last 7 days.

type.description: What the value is: ip_address, email_address, phone_number, billing_address, shipping_address, device_id and the like, or the name of one of your own tracking variables.

recent_unique_user_values.description: For your own tracking variables sent with the lookup (such as a user ID), how many different values of each kind IPQS has seen with them recently. Empty when none were sent.

recent_occurrences.description: How many different values of that kind were seen.

type.description: The variable and the kind of value counted, e.g. unique_userID_ip_addresses or unique_userID_email_addresses.

request_id.description: IPQS's ID for this lookup. Pass it to Report fraud to report the lookup as fraudulent, or to Get past lookup to read it again.

result_type.description: How the result was produced: live (a full check now), cached (from recent checks) or fast (a quicker, less accurate check).

risky_tld.description: Whether the domain ends in a top-level domain often used for malware, scams or phishing.

sanitized_email.description: The address with aliases and masking removed, such as the extra dots in a Gmail address.

smtp_score.description: How the mail server answered, -1 to 3: -1 invalid address, 0 the server rejects all mail, 1 a temporary error, 2 the server accepts all mail, 3 the server confirmed the address.

spam_trap_score.description: How confident IPQS is that the address is an active spam trap: high, medium, low or none. Scrub high (and, to be stricter, medium) from promotional mailings.

spf_record.description: Whether the domain has a proper SPF record.

suggested_domain.description: The domain the address was probably meant to have, when it looks like a typo of a popular mail service (gmai.com for gmail.com). Null when there is no suggestion.

suspect.description: Whether the mail server gave a temporary error or a broken handshake, so valid may not be reliable. Also true for catch-all domains.

timed_out.description: Whether checking with the mail server timed out. A timed-out lookup that says the address is not valid should not be trusted; raise the timeout and try again.

user_activity.description: How often the address is used for legitimate purchases and sign ups: high, medium, low or none. High and medium are strong signs of a real user. Higher plans only.

valid.description: Whether the address appears valid. For a mailing list, keep addresses that are valid, not disposable and whose spam_trap_score is not high.

validate_phone_number.description: Check whether a phone number is real and safe to accept: whether it is valid and active, its line type (mobile, landline, VOIP, toll free), carrier and location, whether it is prepaid, risky, a spammer or recently abusive, with a fraud score. An invalid number comes back with valid false, not an error.

parameters.description: The phone number to check. Spaces, dashes and brackets are fine. With fewer than 10 digits it needs its country code after a +, or its country under Countries.
parameters.name: phone_number

parameters.description: The countries the number is likely from, as two-letter codes like US, GB or DE. IPQS prefers them when reading the number, and needs one for a short number without a country code.
parameters.name: countries

parameters.description: How strict the check is, 0 to 2. IPQS recommends starting at 0; stricter checks flag more, honest ones included.
parameters.name: strictness

parameters.description: Your own tracking variables to record with the lookup, such as userID or transactionID, so you can find it again in your history and IPQS can spot patterns per user. Each must first be set up in your IPQS account settings.

accurate_country_code.description: Whether the number's dialing code matches one of the countries given with the lookup.

active.description: Whether the number is live and reachable. An add-on IPQS enables on request; null without it.

active_status.description: The line's status, with enhanced line checks enabled: Active Line (with a High, Medium or Low Confidence when IPQS can tell), Disconnected Line, Phone Turned Off or Inconclusive Status. Null when unknown.

associated_email_addresses.description: Email addresses linked to the number. Upgraded plans only.

status.description: What IPQS found, or why there are none, in its words.

carrier.description: The carrier the number is assigned to, when known.

country.description: Two-letter code of the number's country, e.g. US.

dialing_code.description: The country dialing code, 1 to 4 digits, e.g. 1. Null when unknown.

do_not_call.description: Whether the number is on a Do Not Call list. United States and Canada only; null when the feature is not enabled.

formatted.description: The number in international format, e.g. +18007132618.

fraud_score.description: IPQS's fraud score for the number, 0 to 100. 75 and above is suspicious, 85 and above is risky, and 90 and above has already been used for abuse.

identity_data.description: An Enterprise add-on: identity details from authoritative sources such as credit bureaus and telecoms, one entry per person, with names, addresses, email addresses, phone numbers and age, exactly as IPQS sends them. Null when the account does not have the add-on.

leaked.description: Whether the number was recently exposed in a data breach.

line_type.description: The kind of line: Wireless, Landline, Toll-Free, VOIP, Satellite, Premium Rate or Pager. Null when unknown.

local_format.description: The number as it is written in its own country, e.g. (800) 713-2618.

mcc.description: The mobile country code, typically 3 digits. Null for landlines, toll free numbers and when unknown.

mnc.description: The mobile network code of the carrier, typically 3 digits. Null for landlines, toll free numbers and when unknown.

name.description: The name of the number's owner, a person or a business, when known. Several are separated by commas.

number_recycling.description: An add-on: whether the number recently changed owners or carriers. Its fields are null without it.

last_ported_date.description: When the number last moved carrier, as IPQS writes it.

message.description: IPQS's note on the check, such as that it is not enabled.

ported.description: Whether the number moved to a different carrier from its original one.

recently_recycled.description: Whether the number was recently given to a new owner.

phone_number.description: The phone number that was checked, as sent.

prepaid.description: Whether the number is on a prepaid plan.

recent_abuse.description: Whether the number has been tied to recent or ongoing fraud.

recent_data_matches.description: How often IPQS has seen the values sent in this lookup over the last 7 days, one entry per value. Empty when it has none to report.

recent_occurrences.description: How many times IPQS has seen it in the last 7 days.

type.description: What the value is: ip_address, email_address, phone_number, billing_address, shipping_address, device_id and the like, or the name of one of your own tracking variables.

recent_unique_user_values.description: For your own tracking variables sent with the lookup (such as a user ID), how many different values of each kind IPQS has seen with them recently. Empty when none were sent.

recent_occurrences.description: How many different values of that kind were seen.

type.description: The variable and the kind of value counted, e.g. unique_userID_ip_addresses or unique_userID_email_addresses.

region.description: The number's region or state, when known.

request_id.description: IPQS's ID for this lookup. Pass it to Report fraud to report the lookup as fraudulent, or to Get past lookup to read it again.

risky.description: Whether the number is tied to fraud, scams, robocalls, fake accounts or other unfriendly behavior.

sms_domain.description: The carrier's domain for sending email to the phone as text, e.g. tmomail.net, when it has one.

sms_email.description: The carrier's email address for texting the phone, e.g. 5555551234@tmomail.net, when it has one.

sms_pumping.description: An add-on: how likely the number is to be used for SMS pumping fraud. Its fields are null without it.

velocity.description: The risk as low, medium or high.

spammer.description: Whether the number has recently been reported for spam or harassing calls or texts.

tcpa_blacklist.description: Whether the number belongs to, or is tied to, someone who often files TCPA lawsuits. An add-on; null without it.

timezone.description: The number's time zone, when known.

user_activity.description: How often the number is used for legitimate purchases and sign ups: high, medium, low or none. Higher plans only.

valid.description: Whether the number is properly formatted and assigned to a carrier in its country.

voip.description: Whether the number is a VOIP (internet) or other digital number.

zip_code.description: The number's postal code, when known.

description: Detect fraud with IPQualityScore (IPQS): score how risky an IP address, email address, phone number, link, file or whole transaction is, spot proxies, VPNs, bots, disposable emails, VOIP numbers, phishing and malware, and check for credentials leaked on the dark web. Manage your allowlist and blocklist, report fraud, record conversions, run bulk validations and Fraud Flows, and read your lookup history and credit usage. Needs an IPQualityScore account; the free plan includes 1,000 lookups a month.
